prompt: As an administrator, you need to set a Sieve filter to automatically reject emails that are sent to "noreply@mydomain.com". Which Sieve rule should you use?
choices: `if address :is "from" "noreply@mydomain.com" { reject "This address does not accept incoming emails."; }`
`if address :is "to" "noreply@mydomain.com" { reject "This address does not accept incoming emails."; }`
explanation: The rule tests the "to" address against noreply@mydomain.com and uses the `reject` action to refuse the message and notify the sender.
